label: Family justice matters
definition: Umbrella category for civil, administrative and mixed proceedings concerning family relationships, children, support, protection and relationship breakdown
notes: Not itself used for gold observations when a more specific type is available

label: Divorce dissolution and nullity
definition: Proceedings to dissolve, terminate or annul a marriage or legally recognised relationship
notes: Record whether ancillary financial or parenting issues are included

label: Private-law parenting
definition: Disputes between private parties about custody, residence, contact, access or parental responsibility

label: Public-law child protection
definition: Proceedings in which a public authority seeks protective, care, dependency or equivalent orders concerning a child
notes: Separate court process from child welfare service events

label: Civil family-violence protection
definition: Civil or quasi-civil applications for protection, restraining or intervention orders connected with family or domestic violence
notes: Criminal prosecutions remain adjacent unless combined in source reporting

label: Maintenance and support
definition: Proceedings concerning child support, spousal maintenance or equivalent financial support obligations
notes: Administrative child-support systems may require a distinct institutional profile

label: Property and financial relief
definition: Proceedings concerning property division, financial adjustment or ancillary relief following relationship breakdown
notes: Do not combine with maintenance without a source flag

label: Adoption guardianship and kinship care
definition: Proceedings establishing adoption, guardianship, kinship care or comparable long-term legal responsibility
notes: Record whether uncontested administrative approvals are included

label: Parentage and assisted reproduction
definition: Proceedings determining legal parentage or selected legal consequences of assisted reproduction

label: Cross-border children matters
definition: International child abduction, return, access and cross-border child-protection proceedings
notes: HCCH convention and non-convention pathways should be distinguishable

label: Juvenile criminal justice
definition: Criminal or delinquency proceedings involving children or young people
notes: Not pooled with core family-justice measures

label: Probate and succession
definition: Proceedings concerning estates, succession, wills or probate
notes: Included only where reporting systems inseparably combine categories

label: Criminal family-violence proceedings
definition: Criminal prosecutions or sentencing processes for family or domestic violence offences
